title: Canonical compact-support realization coordinates
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$ and a finite coefficient extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and use schemes in the same universe as $E$. For a compactification $c=(X\xrightarrow{j}Z\xrightarrow{g}Y)$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], let $P^0= j_{!,R}\mathbin{;}Rg_{*,R}$ be the separately derived completed-ring word. Use the strict reduction/limit calculus and operations $o$ [def-sf-integral-system-operations], its realization model $m$ and canonical bridge $b$, and the actual ringed pullback, proper image and open extension [def-sf-integral-system-canonical-bridge]. Define the proper reduction map by applying reduction to proper image of the actual reduction-unit, then the inverse model comparison, and then the reduction/limit counit. Define systemComparison as this proper reduction map followed by proper image of the inverse-or-zero of the open reduction mate [def-zl-integral-generator-admissibility-inverse]. Define systemPresentation as the canonical bridge's open comparison followed by its proper comparison, into the simultaneous system support of [def-pur-semilinear-compact-support-coefficient-transport].

For a scalar-realization datum $A_T$ of [lem-weil-pbc-condensed-e-realization], define encoding as the recorded internal-module/section equivalence of [lem-pur-compact-support-condensed-realization]. Define realize as the inverse completed coefficient presentation [def-pur-completed-coefficient-presentation-transport], followed by derived scalar extension along $A_T$'s specified integral inclusion, followed by inverse encoding. Define its right adjoint restrict by reversing this composite with scalar restriction. Define the ordinary restriction/direct-image square as the sectionwise identity square and its derived restrictionSquare by the canonical right-derived composition comparisons. Define realizationPull as the unique left-adjoint comparison conjugate to this square; properRealization is its geometric counit mate. Define openRealizationInverse as its open-unit mate, and openRealization by inverse-or-zero. Finally, on the completed bounded constructible integral category [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete], define latticeComparison by the recorded scalar-extension normalization and the coefficient-presentation and encoding unitors. These are the actual maps and presentation isomorphisms; no factorization or invertibility assertion on a restricted geometric or Tor-window domain is included.
